title: The Newsroom - America is not the greatest country in the world anymore...(Restricted language)
summary: The opening scene of HBO's The Newsroom, in which anchor Will McAvoy answers a student's question about why America is the greatest country. He delivers a blunt speech arguing it no longer is.
